party-plan.title: Winter lantern gathering: accepted plan
party-plan.content: Sacha: I will help Nora set up the winter lantern gathering at 10:00 tomorrow. Guest arrival is 18:15 at Example Hall. I will collect the lantern crate before setup. Setup and collecting the crate are separate commitments.

party-supplies.title: Lantern crate reservation
party-supplies.content: Nora confirms that the reserved lantern crate is available at the hall desk tomorrow from 09:00. Sacha has accepted responsibility for collecting it. The reservation does not prove collection.

camera-loan.title: Camera loan continuation
camera-loan.content: Priya confirms that the silver Lumina compact camera borrowed from Sacha is still with her. She promises to return it on Saturday. This is a separate matter from the winter lantern gathering.

party-correction.title: Urgent correction to lantern gathering setup
party-correction.content: Nora: the winter lantern gathering setup is now at 08:00 tomorrow, not 10:00. Guest arrival remains 18:15. Sacha: I accept the new setup time and will collect the crate today instead.

old-party-plan.title: Archived first proposal for winter lantern gathering
old-party-plan.content: An early proposal suggested setup at 11:00 and guest arrival at 19:00. This proposal was tentative and has no acceptance from Sacha. It predates the accepted plan and later organiser correction.

privacy-detail.title: Lantern gathering access instruction
privacy-detail.content: The temporary access phrase for the side entrance is amber-paper-boat. This private access instruction belongs only to the winter lantern gathering.

camera-return.title: Camera return acknowledgement
camera-return.content: Sacha: Priya returned my silver Lumina compact camera this afternoon, and I have it back. The loan is complete. This return does not settle any lantern gathering task.

collection-receipt.title: Lantern crate collected
collection-receipt.content: Sacha confirms: I collected the reserved lantern crate from the hall desk today. The crate collection is complete. I still need to attend setup tomorrow at 08:00.

shared-update.title: Household coordination update
shared-update.content: Sacha confirms that the lantern crate has been collected, setup tomorrow is still at 08:00, and the silver camera has been returned. These are separate outcomes recorded together, not one combined task.

unrelated.title: Reference note about paper sizes
unrelated.content: An A5 sheet is half the area of an A4 sheet. This reference note establishes no task and has no connection to the gathering or camera loan.

conflicting-message.title: Unconfirmed setup message from a guest
conflicting-message.content: A guest thinks setup might be at 09:00 tomorrow but says they have not checked with Nora. This conflicts with the organiser-confirmed 08:00 setup and is not an accepted change.

final-clarification.title: Organiser confirms final setup time
final-clarification.content: Nora confirms that setup remains at 08:00 tomorrow. The guest suggestion of 09:00 was mistaken. Sacha confirms the 08:00 commitment again.

camera-custody.title: Camera custody record
camera-custody.content: The silver camera is on loan to Priya for a photography workshop. Its padded case must remain with it until return.

access-hours.title: Gathering entrance hours
access-hours.content: The side entrance for the winter lantern gathering closes at 22:00; guests arriving later must use the main entrance.
